description: UI developers need to know why an element is behind another element, clipped unexpectedly, or trapped inside a stacking context.

css_snippet.description: Must be a non-empty CSS text snippet. Ignore unsupported at-rules gracefully and continue parsing what can be understood.

html_snippet.description: Must be a non-empty HTML text snippet. The tool must parse a static DOM tree from this input only.

selected_element.description: Must identify exactly one element in the provided HTML. Accept a CSS selector or element path string. If it matches zero or multiple elements, return a selection error.

show_paint_order.description: Boolean flag controlling whether the paint order trace is included in the result.

show_stacking_context_chain.description: Boolean flag controlling whether the stacking context chain is included in the result.

name: css-stacking-context-and-paint-order-inspector
title: CSS Stacking Context and Paint Order Inspector
